title: AdaMatsuri
subtitle: Full Stack Event Discovery & Booking App

description.name: Event Discovery
description.text: Built a single-page application focused on event discovery and ticket booking for the anime community, with live search, categorical filtering, tag chips, and paginated results.

description.name: Role-Based Access
description.text: Created a role-based access system with protected routes, enabling event organizers to publish and manage their listings through a dedicated dashboard.

description.name: Booking Flow
description.text: Implemented an attendee reservation flow that authenticates users via phone number to generate booking codes.

description.name: Two User Journeys
description.text: Developed a mobile-first job board application for two distinct user journeys: job seekers and employers.

description.name: Data Fetching
description.text: Engineered a centralized data-fetching architecture using custom hooks to deduplicate reads and protect against stale responses.

description.name: Secure Auth
description.text: Implemented a server-side proxy layer to manage authentication and refresh token flows securely.

description.name: REST API
description.text: Designed and built an independent RESTful API using Express.js and MongoDB to handle job logic, user accounts, and secure CV uploads via Cloudflare R2.

description.name: Literary Platform
description.text: Developed a responsive platform allowing users to publish stories, curate reading lists, and discover new content.

description.name: Rich-Text Editor
description.text: Integrated the Tiptap editor, enabling authors to format and publish stories complete with cover images and metadata.

description.name: Type-Safe API
description.text: Used OpenAPI-generated interfaces to ensure strict type safety across the application.

description.name: State & Theming
description.text: Managed user sessions, bookshelf synchronization, and notifications with Pinia, and implemented a custom Light/Dark theme toggle via Vuetify configuration.
